title: Normalization of finite-extension continuous coefficient sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\ell$ be prime, and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite in universe zero [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Compare the continuous spectral-norm coefficient sheaves $A_X\to E_X$ [def-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-coefficients] with the lattice coefficient sheaves constructed from the lifted field $\mathrm{ULift}(E)$ equipped with its canonical absolute value [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-sheaf-locally-constant]. There are isomorphisms from the lifted integral and rational coefficient sheaves to $A_X$ and $E_X$ which commute with their inclusion maps. If $L$ is a finite locally free $E_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its restriction of scalars along the rational isomorphism is finite locally free.

proof.text: The lift algebra equivalence preserves minimal polynomials and therefore the spectral norm. Its composite with WithAbs.equiv is an isometry. The characterization of the coefficient integer ring by absolute value at most one restricts it to an isometric ring equivalence of the integral coefficients.

Postcomposition of continuous functions with each isometric ring equivalence and its inverse gives objectwise ring isomorphisms. They are natural under precomposition. The two coefficient maps commute sectionwise, giving the required square of sheaves.

Push forward the module along the rational coefficient isomorphism on the identity site. Keep the original covering and transport each finite set of free generators on its covering slice. Restriction along the coefficient isomorphism identifies the unit modules and preserves colimits, so the transported generating maps remain isomorphisms. The generic restriction step is exposed as finiteLocallyFree_restrict and also reused by integral lattice pair transport, so there is only one proof of it.

lean.statement: theorem lisse_coefficient_normalization (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (lisseFieldSheaf l E X))) (hL : L.IsFiniteLocallyFree) : ∃ eA : latticeCoefficientSheaf X (latticeCoefficientIntegers l (ULift.{u} E)) ≅ lisseIntegerSheaf l E X, ∃ eE : latticeCoefficientSheaf X (WithAbs (Padic.coefficientExtensionAbsoluteValue l (ULift.{u} E))) ≅ lisseFieldSheaf l E X, integralLatticeCoefficientMap X l (ULift.{u} E) ≫ eE.hom = eA.hom ≫ lisseIntegerToField l E X ∧ SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree ((SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := 𝟭 X.ProEt) ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map eE.hom)).obj L)
